d:
How long has it been since the giant goth girl form your college had shrunken you?

Day? Week? Or perhaps even month?

Nonetheless, it doesn't matter. You are at the mercy of her whims, so the best you can do is please her lewd desires, hoping she won't get tired of you. Unless...

You wake up before your goddess enthusiastically tell you that she will be taking you with her to college today.

You can't but help think, that perhaps this is the chance you have been waiting for. If you are able to escape there, then maybe someone you know might find you and help you return to your original size.

What a foolish thought that is though. How can a puny bug like yourself escape from the dominating grasp of a goddess.

Will you risk your lift to escape and in failing to do so incur her wrath, or will you act as her obedient servant, living the rest of her life as mommy's living pleasure toy?
